## Coinbase - Senior Software Engineer, Backend – Payments Platform

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/coinbase/jobs/8247401)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s scalable fiat payment infrastructure and APIs. Expanding payment methods and rails while improving reliability, observability, and transaction success rates.
Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s scalable fiat payments infrastructure and APIs
- Salary: $186,065 - $218,900 per year
- Tech stack: Distributed Systems, Microservices, Ruby on Rails, Go
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.
- Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend payment-processing services using Go
- Own end-to-end delivery of payment features from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration
- Build platform primitives, extension points, and self-serve APIs for adding payment methods and rails
- Partner with engineers, product managers, and senior leadership to translate product and business requirements into quarterly technical plans
- Improve reliability, observability, and performance across payment services
- Identify and resolve system bottlenecks
- Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and service-oriented architecture best practices
- Build infrastructure, workflows, and APIs powering fiat on- and off-ramps for global customers
- 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering
- Hands-on experience building and maintaining production services in a service-oriented or microservices architecture
- Proficiency in Go or similar backend languages
- Experience designing scalable, low-latency APIs and distributed systems
- Track record of owning features end-to-end, from design through deployment and production support
- Experience with financial systems, payments infrastructure, or high-volume transactional systems requiring precision and auditability
- Responsible use of generative AI with human oversight
- Eligible to work in the USA, as indicated by the US-only remote location and US applicant notices

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s scalable fiat payment infrastructure and APIs. Expanding payment methods and rails while improving reliability, observability, and transaction success rates.
Senior backend engineer building Coinbase’s scalable fiat payments infrastructure and APIs
Role description:
• Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend payment-processing services using Go
• Own end-to-end delivery of payment features from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration
• Build platform primitives, extension points, and self-serve APIs for adding payment methods and rails
• Partner with engineers, product managers, and senior leadership to translate product and business requirements into quarterly technical plans
• Improve reliability, observability, and performance across payment services
• Identify and resolve system bottlenecks
• Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and service-oriented architecture best practices
• Build infrastructure, workflows, and APIs powering fiat on- and off-ramps for global customers
Role requirements:
• 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering
• Hands-on experience building and maintaining production services in a service-oriented or microservices architecture
• Proficiency in Go or similar backend languages
• Experience designing scalable, low-latency APIs and distributed systems
• Track record of owning features end-to-end, from design through deployment and production support
• Experience with financial systems, payments infrastructure, or high-volume transactional systems requiring precision and auditability
• Responsible use of generative AI with human oversight
• Eligible to work in the USA, as indicated by the US-only remote location and US applicant notices
